name: native-select
title: Native Select
description: shadcn/ui's base-nova native select, fixed: in dark, no fill, its border alone (3:1) outlining it, so it is not a grey slab on a card or a dialog. Its selection's colours are its own (::selection), not its descendants' too, a rule every element of the page tried on every restyle. Its spacing on the 4px module (docs/grid.md).
